stories.headline: South Korea Chip Exports Hit Record $32.8B in March, Up 151% YoY, as Companies Front-Load Orders

key_facts.fact: South Korean chip exports more than doubled year-over-year to $32.84 billion in March 2026, up 151.4%, topping the $30 billion mark for the first time on record.
key_facts.excerpt: Chip exports more than doubled from a year earlier to $32.84 billion, up 151.4 percent, topping the $30 billion mark for the first time on record.

key_facts.fact: Total South Korean exports hit an all-time monthly high of $86.13 billion in March, up 48% YoY, surpassing the previous peak of $69.5 billion set in December 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Exports rose 48 percent from a year earlier to $86.13 billion, according to the Trade Ministry. That was the highest monthly total on record, surpassing the previous peak of $69.5 billion set in December 2025.

key_facts.fact: Companies rushed semiconductor orders due to fears of supply chain disruptions from the Middle East conflict threatening helium supplies critical to chip manufacturing.
key_facts.excerpt: Businesses step up purchases of semiconductors as Iran war threatens helium supplies

key_facts.fact: Exports to China jumped 65% YoY to $16.5 billion driven by semiconductors, while exports to the US rose 47% to $16.34 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Exports to China jumped 65 percent from a year earlier to $16.5 billion, driven by gains in semiconductors and petrochemicals... Exports to the US rose about 47 percent to $16.34 billion.

key_facts.fact: Korea posted a trade surplus of $25.74 billion in March, extending its surplus streak to 14 consecutive months.
key_facts.excerpt: Korea posted a trade surplus of $25.74 billion in March, extending its surplus streak to 14 consecutive months.

stories.headline: Nvidia and Tesla Turn to Samsung as TSMC 3nm Overload and 2nm Sellout Through 2028 Squeeze AI Chip Supply

key_facts.fact: TSMC's 3nm process has entered a state of 'overload' as chip designers and hyperscale cloud providers compete aggressively for limited capacity, forcing companies like Nvidia and Tesla to seek alternatives.
key_facts.excerpt: A severe capacity crunch at Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Ltd. is forcing major clients, including Nvidia Corp. and Tesla Inc., to seek alternatives, positioning Samsung Electronics Co. Ltd. as a rare second source for cutting-edge chips.

key_facts.fact: TSMC has fully booked its 2-nanometer chip capacity through 2028, with even its future Arizona Fab 4 (set for 2030 production) already reserved.
key_facts.excerpt: Taiwan Semiconductor has fully booked its 2-nanometer chip capacity through 2028 as demand from Nvidia Corp., Advanced Micro Devices Inc., Apple Inc., and others surges amid the AI boom... Even its future Arizona Fab 4, set for 2030 production, is already reserved.

key_facts.fact: Samsung Foundry has secured chip orders from Tesla and Nvidia and may return to profitability this year, positioning itself as the only other player capable of producing 2nm chips.
key_facts.excerpt: The supply crunch is creating an opening for Samsung Foundry, the only other player capable of producing 2nm chips. Samsung has secured orders from Tesla and Nvidia and may return to profitability this year.

key_facts.fact: TSMC held a 72% share of the pure-play foundry market in Q4, while Samsung ranked a distant second with 7%.
key_facts.excerpt: Taiwan Semiconductor maintained its dominance in the pure-play foundry market, holding a 72% share in the fourth quarter... Samsung ranked a distant second with a 7% market share.

sources.title: Why Nvidia And Tesla Are Suddenly Knocking On Samsung's Door
Samsung Foundry Gains Momentum Amid TSMC Capacity Strain

stories.headline: Samsung and AMD Sign MoU on HBM4 Memory Supply and Potential Foundry Cooperation for AI Chips

key_facts.fact: Samsung and AMD signed a memorandum of understanding covering HBM4 memory supply and possible future foundry cooperation for AI chips.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung and Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) signed a memorandum of understanding covering HBM4 memory supply and possible future foundry cooperation for AI chips.

key_facts.fact: The agreement centers on Samsung providing HBM4 for AMD's MI455X AI GPUs, planned for its Helios rack-scale AI infrastructure platform.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement centers on Samsung providing HBM4 for AMD's MI455X AI GPUs, which are planned for its Helios rack scale AI infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: The MoU also covers advanced DRAM for next-generation EPYC CPUs, linking AMD's GPU and CPU roadmaps under a single supply partnership.
key_facts.excerpt: The memorandum also covers advanced DRAM for next generation EPYC CPUs, so it links GPU and CPU roadmaps rather than treating them as separate product lines.

sources.title: Samsung And AMD Tie HBM4 Supply To Wider AI Chip Ambitions

stories.headline: Baidu Robotaxis Freeze Across Wuhan in Mass System Failure, Trapping Passengers on Highways

key_facts.fact: A system failure caused multiple Baidu Apollo Go robotaxis to freeze on roads across Wuhan on the night of March 31, with at least 100 vehicles affected.
key_facts.excerpt: A 'system failure' caused a robotaxi outage involving multiple vehicles operated by Baidu's Apollo Go in central Chinese city of Wuhan... At least 100 Apollo Go vehicles were affected.

key_facts.fact: Some passengers were trapped inside the stalled vehicles for nearly two hours, though police confirmed all passengers exited safely with no injuries.
key_facts.excerpt: Local media reported that some passengers were trapped inside the vehicles for nearly two hours. Passengers were able to exit the vehicles safely and there were no injuries, police said.

key_facts.fact: Apollo Go customer service attributed the driving system abnormality to network issues; industry insiders said the stalling was likely caused by a safety self-check mechanism.
key_facts.excerpt: Apollo Go customer service representatives told local media the driving system abnormality was caused by network issues... The stalling of Apollo Go vehicles was likely due to unexpected circumstances that triggered a safety self-check mechanism.

key_facts.fact: Apollo Go has provided over 20 million cumulative rides globally across 26 cities; Q4 2025 fully driverless orders surged over 200% year-over-year to 3.4 million.
key_facts.excerpt: As of February 2026, Apollo Go's services have been deployed in 26 cities globally, with cumulative orders exceeding 20 million... Apollo Go provided 3.4 million fully driverless ride-hailing orders in the fourth quarter of last year, surging more than 200% from the same period a year earlier.

key_facts.fact: The incident echoes a December 2025 event where a San Francisco power outage caused Waymo robotaxis to stall and snarl traffic.
key_facts.excerpt: A widespread power outage in San Francisco at the end of last year also caused Waymo robotaxis to stall and snarl traffic.

stories.headline: Microsoft, Chevron, and Engine No. 1 Sign Exclusivity Deal for $7B Natural Gas Power Plant in West Texas

key_facts.fact: Microsoft, Chevron, and investment fund Engine No. 1 signed an exclusivity agreement for power generation and supply, tied to a proposed natural gas-fired power plant in West Texas.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft, Chevron and investment fund Engine No. 1 have entered into an exclusivity agreement for power generation and supply, the three companies said on Tuesday.

key_facts.fact: The proposed facility has a projected cost of roughly $7 billion and would initially generate 2,500 megawatts of electricity to power a large data center campus.
key_facts.excerpt: The discussions are tied to a proposed natural gas-fired power plant in West Texas, with a reported value of around $7 billion. Initially, the facility could generate approximately 2,500 megawatts of electricity.

key_facts.fact: Chevron and Engine No. 1 had already announced a partnership last year to build natural gas-based power plants next to data centers using GE Vernova turbines.
key_facts.excerpt: Chevron and Engine No. 1 had already announced a partnership last year to build natural gas-based power plants next to data centers in the U.S., with the two planning to use turbines by electric services company GE Vernova.

key_facts.fact: Chevron had previously said its first AI data center power project in West Texas targets start-up by 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Chevron had in November said its first project to power an AI data center using natural gas will be built in West Texas with the goal of start-up by 2027.

stories.headline: CoreWeave Closes $8.5B GPU-Backed Loan, First Investment-Grade Rated GPU Financing

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave closed an $8.5 billion delayed-draw term loan facility to expand its AI cloud platform, the first investment-grade rated GPU-backed financing.
key_facts.excerpt: Cloud infrastructure firm CoreWeave has secured $8.5 billion in financing through a delayed-draw term loan facility to expand its artificial intelligence cloud platform.

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave can initially borrow about $7.5 billion, with an option to increase to $8.5 billion as data-center assets reach stable operating levels. The loan matures in March 2032.
key_facts.excerpt: CoreWeave will initially be able to borrow about $7.5 billion, with an option to increase that to $8.5 billion as data-center assets reach stable operating levels. The loan will mature in March 2032.

key_facts.fact: The facility was co-structured by Morgan Stanley and MUFG, with Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan as additional lead arrangers, anchored by Blackstone Credit & Insurance.
key_facts.excerpt: The facility was co-structured and book-run by Morgan Stanley and MUFG, with Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan serving as additional coordinating lead arrangers... anchored by Blackstone Credit & Insurance.

key_facts.fact: This brings CoreWeave's total equity and debt financing commitments in the past 12 months to about $28 billion. Stock jumped 12% on the news.
key_facts.excerpt: This brings the total equity and debt financing commitments secured by CoreWeave in the past 12 months to about $28 billion.

stories.headline: Grab and WeRide Launch Southeast Asia's First Driverless Ride Service in Singapore's Punggol District

key_facts.fact: WeRide and Grab officially commenced public operations for the Ai.R autonomous ride service in Singapore's Punggol residential district on March 31, making Grab Southeast Asia's first ride-hailing provider to offer a driverless service.
key_facts.excerpt: WeRide and Grab today officially commenced public operations for the Ai.R (Autonomously Intelligent Ride) service in Punggol. Starting today, the public can experience Singapore's first autonomous passenger service ever deployed within a residential estate.

key_facts.fact: The Ai.R fleet has served more than 1,000 early riders and clocked over 30,000 km of autonomous mileage since a January 2026 trial phase.
key_facts.excerpt: Since January 2026, more than 1,000 passengers — including Punggol residents and community leaders — trialled the service... the Ai.R fleet has safely clocked 30,000km of autonomous mileage.

key_facts.fact: The service uses WeRide's GXR and Robobus autonomous vehicle models, with 14 Grab driver-partners trained as certified Safety Operators riding onboard during the initial phase.
key_facts.excerpt: The Ai.R service is operated by Grab and features WeRide's GXR and Robobus autonomous vehicle models... 14 Grab driver-partners have successfully completed specialised training with WeRide and GrabAcademy to become certified Safety Operators.

key_facts.fact: Rides are free until commercial service begins in mid-2026. The fleet operates weekdays 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM on two shuttle routes plus a 20-minute mini route.
key_facts.excerpt: Rides will be free till commercial service begins in mid-2026... The Ai.R fleet operates on weekdays (Monday-Friday) from 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM.

stories.headline: Tesla Admits Its Robotaxis Are Sometimes Fully Driven by Remote Human Operators

key_facts.fact: In a letter to Senator Ed Markey, Tesla disclosed that its robotaxi remote operators are allowed to directly control vehicles, unlike six other AV companies (including Waymo and Zoox) that said their remote assistants do not directly control vehicles.
key_facts.excerpt: In the documents, submitted to Markey as part of an investigation into self-driving-vehicle technology... seven companies, including Tesla, Amazon-owned Zoox, and Uber- and Nvidia-funded Nuro, released new details about their 'remote assistance' programs.

key_facts.fact: Tesla simultaneously expanded its unsupervised robotaxi geofence in Austin to roughly 245 square miles (12x its original 20 sq mi), but the unsupervised fleet consists of fewer than a dozen vehicles.
key_facts.excerpt: The overall robotaxi geofence in Austin has grown to roughly 245 square miles — about 12 times its original 20-square-mile footprint... the unsupervised fleet consists of fewer than a dozen vehicles, with only a few operating at the same time.

key_facts.fact: The total Austin fleet is roughly 37-42 vehicles, with the vast majority still carrying in-car safety monitors; 'unsupervised' vehicles are still remotely supervised by Tesla.
key_facts.excerpt: The total Austin fleet sits at roughly 37-42 vehicles, with the vast majority still carrying safety monitors... There's no human safety monitor inside the car, but Tesla still remotely supervises these vehicles.

key_facts.fact: Waymo by comparison is delivering 500,000 paid fully driverless rides per week across 10 US cities, targeting 1 million weekly rides by year-end.
key_facts.excerpt: Waymo is now delivering 500,000 paid robotaxi rides per week across 10 U.S. cities — fully driverless, no chase cars, no safety monitors, 24 hours a day.

sources.title: Tesla Admits Its Robotaxis Are Sometimes Driven by Remote Humans

stories.headline: Constellation Asks FERC to Speed Up Three Mile Island Nuclear Restart After Grid Operator Flags 2031 Delay

key_facts.fact: Constellation Energy filed a request with FERC on Tuesday to transfer grid connection rights from its Eddystone gas-fired plant to Three Mile Island (renamed Crane Clean Energy Center) to speed up its restart timeline.
key_facts.excerpt: The company will ask the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission on Tuesday to transfer certain rights that allow it to send electricity to the grid from its Eddystone gas-fired power plant outside of Philadelphia to Crane site.

key_facts.fact: Grid operator PJM Interconnection gave initial feedback that Three Mile Island may not be able to connect to the electrical system until 2031, but Constellation says it still plans to restart by end of 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Recent initial feedback from grid operator PJM Interconnection, however, said the site may not be able to connect to the electrical system until 2031... 'We are working on that with PJM, and we continue to expect to start this unit in 2027,' CEO Joseph Dominguez said.

key_facts.fact: The $1.6 billion Crane relaunch, first announced in 2024, is intended to deliver electricity to power Microsoft data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: The giant U.S. power producer is working to resume operations of a reactor at the shut Three Mile Island, under the new name Crane Clean Energy Center, to deliver electricity to the regional grid to power Microsoft data centers by the end of next year.

sources.title: Constellation to ask regulators for help speeding up Three Mile Island nuclear power plant restart, CEO says

stories.headline: Autonomous Military Ship Maker Saronic Raises $1.75B at $9.25B Valuation to Scale Navy Production

key_facts.fact: Saronic raised $1.75 billion in a Series D led by Kleiner Perkins, more than doubling its valuation to $9.25 billion from $4 billion in early 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: The round, led by Kleiner Perkins, more than doubles Saronic's valuation to $9.25 billion from the $4 billion it hit after a $600 million raise early last year.

key_facts.fact: Saronic plans to build more than 20 autonomous ships per year by 2027 and is potentially building a new shipyard (Port Alpha) in Texas.
key_facts.excerpt: Saronic plans to use the funding to scale its supply chain and shipyards, and build more than 20 ships a year by 2027. The company is potentially building its new shipyard, dubbed Port Alpha, in Texas.

key_facts.fact: Saronic's main shipyard in Franklin, Louisiana is undergoing a $300 million expansion, with plans to quintuple production over the next 12 months.
key_facts.excerpt: Saronic's main shipyard in Franklin, Louisiana, is currently undergoing a $300 million expansion. Mavrookas said the company is on pace to quintuple production there over the next 12 months.

key_facts.fact: The company makes six autonomous surface vessel iterations and signed a $392 million Navy contract last year. The Iran war and Strait of Hormuz bottleneck are driving demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Last year, it signed a $392 million Navy contract... The war in Iran and the bottleneck in the Strait of Hormuz are further illustrating the need to integrate newer tools into modern warfare.

sources.title: Autonomous ship startup Saronic raises $1.75 billion

stories.headline: Oracle Cuts Up to 30,000 Jobs as AI Data Center Spending Drains Cash and Stock Plunges 25% YTD

key_facts.fact: Oracle has begun laying off between 20,000 and 30,000 employees (roughly 12-18% of its 162,000-person workforce as of May 2025), with termination emails sent at 6 AM.
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle has started telling employees that it's cutting thousands of jobs... Oracle, which employed 162,000 people as of May 2025, declined to comment.

key_facts.fact: The layoffs come as Oracle's stock price has dropped 25% year-to-date amid investor concerns about rising debt for AI data center buildout. Oracle announced plans to raise $50 billion in debt and equity in January.
key_facts.excerpt: The company's stock price is down 25% this year... In January, Oracle announced plans to raise $50 billion in debt and equity.

key_facts.fact: Oracle's remaining performance obligations jumped 359% to $455 billion following an agreement with OpenAI worth over $300 billion; total RPO now stands at $553 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle disclosed that its remaining performance obligations, a measure of contracted revenue that has not yet been recognized, jumped 359% to $455 billion following an agreement with OpenAI worth over $300 billion.

key_facts.fact: Cutting 20,000-30,000 employees could lead to $8-10 billion in incremental free cash flow, according to TD Cowen analysts.
key_facts.excerpt: Cutting 20,000 to 30,000 employees could lead to $8 billion to $10 billion in incremental free cash flow, TD Cowen analysts wrote in a January note.

sources.title: Oracle cutting thousands in latest layoff round as AI spending booms

key_facts.fact: The Singapore investment follows Microsoft's announcement of plans to invest over $1 billion in Thailand for AI and cloud infrastructure.
